_about: Code in the game that other people wrote, for the notices in a package (Legal RL-289, RL-292 to RL-296; docs/legal/licence-register.md LR-026 to LR-028). One row a snippet: "marker" is a line of the code itself (how a built program and the tree are searched), "files" where it is today. A row with a license puts its notice into NOTICES.txt of any package whose program holds the marker, and the package check refuses the package without it. A row with "license": null has no terms we know: an outside-testers package holding it is refused until the code is replaced. Take a row out when no copy is left (node tools/third-party.mjs --check says so). Headers read at the source: Quilez, the statement on https://iquilezles.org/articles/ (2026-11-28); Hoskins, the header as quoted with its copyright line in a published copy that names the Shadertoy original, which sits behind a bot check (2026-11-28). WTFPL code (LR-028) asks for no notice and has no row.
